close_reason: Fixed: enforce_for_delivery now iterates all recipient domains (deduped) instead of only first()
description: relay_client.rs:310 calls enforce_for_delivery only for envelope.rcpt_to.first(). If an envelope contains recipients across multiple domains (e.g. user@domain-a.com and user@domain-b.com), domain-b's MTA-STS policy is never checked. Trigger: relay_queue groups by peer, not by recipient domain. A multi-recipient envelope could bypass enforcement for any recipient beyond the first. Fix: either enforce per-recipient-domain (with short-circuit on first Permanent error) or document and validate that the relay always issues single-domain envelopes.
title: MTA-STS enforcement only checks first recipient domain
